Variants.Content: Oros is located on the edge of the Sea of ​​Smoke on the Valyrian Peninsula. It is one of the port sites and ruins that still have a name after the doomsday catastrophe. It does not belong to the Seven Kingdoms and lacks the protection of a stable royal power; volcanoes, poisonous fog, broken waterways and rumors about lost treasures make those who approach it must weigh between greed and survival.
Entry Oros Local families also rely on dangerous sea routes, volcanic smoke, rumors of ruins, and hard-to-replenish fresh water; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Oros They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of Valyria; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.

Entry Oros If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

Craftsmen use their hands to measure the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs, and seams left by generations of repairs in Oros. Priests use rituals to perpetuate the doomsday catastrophe, the remains of the Dragon King, and the taboo that sailors are unwilling to take lightly. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Oros They care about dangerous sea routes, volcanic smoke, rumors of ruins, and hard-to-replenish fresh water. They also look at whether seeds are left behind after grain collection, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
